guard: a registered remote user mesh derives its recorded broker but refuses supervision with the host-authority workaround, and a mismatched explicit broker never overrides the registry
_note: The smoke imports `../src/commands.js` directly for the derivation assertion and launches the source CLI through tsx for public-command wording. No build is required for mutations in manager/src/commands.ts.

mutations.name: registered user entries no longer take the remote-host authority refusal branch
mutations.find: return { space: target.space, server: target.server, remoteUser: true };
mutations.replace: return { space: target.space, server: target.server, remoteUser: false };
mutations.expectRed: registered participant gets the honest host-required workaround, never the false down/up advice
mutations.cell: registered participant gets the honest host-required workaround, never the false down/up advice

mutations.name: an explicit server mismatch is accepted instead of refusing a split target
mutations.find:
if (v.server !== undefined && v.server !== target.server)
        throw new Error(`--server ${v.server} does not match registered space "${target.space}" at ${target.server} - supervise refuses to use a different broker than the meshes entry`);
mutations.replace:
if (false)
        throw new Error(`--server ${v.server} does not match registered space "${target.space}" at ${target.server} - supervise refuses to use a different broker than the meshes entry`);
mutations.expectRed: explicit --server mismatch is named before remote-host refusal or dial
mutations.cell: explicit --server mismatch is named before remote-host refusal or dial

mutations.name: an absent registration falls through instead of emitting the host-or-join recovery
mutations.find:
if (isWorkspaceTargetError(error) && error.code === "unknown-space")
      throw new Error(`neither hosting '${localSpace}' (no cotal up root here) nor registered to it (no meshes entry) — \`cotal up\` to host, or \`cotal meshes add\` to join`);
mutations.replace:
if (false)
      throw new Error(`neither hosting '${localSpace}' (no cotal up root here) nor registered to it (no meshes entry) — \`cotal up\` to host, or \`cotal meshes add\` to join`);
mutations.expectRed: neither hosting nor registered gets the exact host-or-join recovery
mutations.cell: neither hosting nor registered gets the exact host-or-join recovery
